description: Request custodial signing consent from the user.

main.description: Ask the user to let this dApp have the PDS sign with a Tier 1 wallet. Grants nothing: the user approves on approveUrl.

dappOrigin.description: The dApp's origin; must match the request's Origin header.

ttlSeconds.description: How long the consent lasts once approved. Default 3600; at most WALLET_CONSENT_MAX_HOURS.

allowedContracts.description: Ethereum addresses (or Solana program ids) transactions may be sent to. Without it the consent signs messages only.

maxValuePerTx.description: Most native value one transaction may move, in wei, as a decimal string. Without it no value may be moved.

maxTotalValue.description: Most native value all transactions under this consent may move together, in wei.

approveUrl.description: Page on this PDS where the user approves the request.

expiresAt.description: When the request lapses if not approved.

errors.name: OriginMismatch
errors.description: dappOrigin does not match the Origin header.
